text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Now that everyone's here, let's do a team 
battle! 
We'll split into this side and that side! 
Losers buy dessert!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ho? That means we are on the opposing 
side to Suzuka-kun 
and Pokke-kun. Hmm, what a splendid chance 
to blow off some daily frustration!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Are we really doing this? 
I mean, Tachyon aside, Air Groove and Cafe 
too...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We're at summer training camp, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"(...And so, we ran around shooting each 
other, everyone getting soaking wet, 
so lost in it that no one even noticed the 
sky turning madder red—)"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Ahahahahaha! Did everyone fall into the 
ocean or what? 
Those desserts are totally ours!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...! W-We did it, Pokke-san...! 
Ugh, my mouth tastes so salty...! Fufu!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Like we'd just take this lying down! 
—Over there! Splash 'em with the bucket, 
Tachyon!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"As you wish! 
Take some seawater, Pokke-kun! Ahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"(To see everyone having this much fun... 
If that's the case, then maybe I can 
too... just a little more—)"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Pff-hah! Hey, using a bucket is playing 
dirty! If that's how it is... 
Let's tackle 'em! Suzuka, let's sink that 
scheming mastermind into the sea...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "What! 'Scheming mastermind'!?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, we'll sink them into the sea...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Suzuka!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: T-Taaaake thiiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*SPLASH!*)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"So goooood♪ Man, these really are super 
delicious here~♪"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, I'm sorry, Air Groove. 
Tackling you into the sea and all... I 
guess I got carried away by the 
momentum..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...No, don't worry about it. Rather— 
Heh. Haha! Ahahahaha...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Fufu, no, it just hit me that the day 
would come when you would shove me into 
the ocean...! 
Just thinking back on it makes me 
laugh...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I never imagined I'd do something 
like that either...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...It's been so long since I've cut loose 
like that. 
...It was fun."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I suppose we can call 
Pokke-kun's operation a success, can't we?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Do not swing them around or throw them. 
One bucket has been distributed 
per room. Make sure you enjoy the 
fireworks safely!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Um. ...May I sit next to you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
...Did you... dislike the water guns...?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see. At first, I was surprised by 
how everyone was acting... 
but before I knew it, I was totally 
engrossed in it too. Besides—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"(The red sunset, the white spray of 
water, everyone's cheerful voices. 
The cold, sweet flavor we had on that 
slightly chilly beach—)"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Strange as it is, I feel like I won't be 
forgetting that moment for quite some 
time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I see... 
...Would you... listen to a story of 
mine...?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...A long time ago, the lock on the shared 
space Tachyon-san and I used broke, 
and the two of us got trapped inside...
